items.title: Apple’s WWDC AI demos looked more real after $250M false ad settlement

items.description: Apple is trying to solve one of Safari's biggest weaknesses with AI. items.title: Apple plays catch-up at WWDC

items.title: How to Keep Quantum Information Alive for Machine Learning
items.description: Quantum Machine Learning promises powerful new ways of processing information, but quantum states are extraordinarily fragile.
